module: 3D visual guides of the Easy Object Select tool during a translation, scaling or rotation. Drawn with debugDrawer: arrows (line + prism) for translation, lines + spheres for scale, 64-segment ring and angle arc for rotation. Colors are red/green/blue for X/Y/Z; the guide length depends on the distance to the camera (0.16 × distance, clamped between 1.5 and 30 m).
notes: The constraint parameter is {axis = "x"|"y"|"z", exclude = boolean}: without exclude only the axis is drawn, with exclude the other two (plane constraint). Without a constraint all three axes are drawn.

axisColors.desc: Returns the axis color table {x, y, z} (ColorF).

returns.desc: Colors of the x, y, z axes.

drawTranslate.desc: Draws the translation arrows from the pivot for the axes concerned by the constraint.

axes.desc: Directions of the x, y, z axes (world or local).

constraint.desc: Axis/plane constraint ({axis, exclude}), or nil for the three axes.

drawScale.desc: Draws the scale guides (line ending in a sphere) for the concerned axes.

axes.desc: Directions of the x, y, z axes.

drawRotation.desc: Draws the rotation ring around the given axis and, if the angle is not zero, a thick arc of the angle traveled from the start vector.

startVector.desc: Start vector projected onto the ring plane.
